# cty.dat

Country (DXCC entity) prefix list by Jim Reisert AD1C,
https://www.country-files.com, the file WSJT-X, JTDX and the contest
loggers use. Read by `src/dxcc.c` for the country shown in the FT8/FT4
table.

This copy: version VER20240202 (Debian package hamradio-files).

A newer list from https://www.country-files.com/cty/cty.dat can be put on
the SD card as `/mnt/cty.dat`; it is used instead of the one in the image.
